name: costgoblin-gcp-focus-exporter
description: Exports the GCP FOCUS 1.2 BigQuery billing export to GCS in the layout CostGoblin syncs from
_dependencyNote: @google-cloud/bigquery is pinned EXACTLY, not floated. The DATE/TIMESTAMP parameter wrapping in export-focus.mjs depends on the client's parameter-encoding behaviour (see `temporalParam`), so a version bump can silently change that behaviour on the next image rebuild. Re-verify that wrapping before bumping.
